title: Subsampling Ethanol Preservative from Zooplankton Museum Collections for DNA Extractions
author: Andreas Novotny
materials: Use a syringe to push the ethanol through a Sterivex Filter (0.2 um) Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #SVGPL10RC .
Alternative extraction method: DNA Extraction from 0.22µm Sterivex Filters - Qiagen Blood and Tissue Kit by Andreas Novotny

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in Sample
steps.instruction: Invert the zooplankton sample jar three times to resuspend the DNA.

steps.title: Collect Ethanol Preservative
steps.instruction: Remove 50 ml of the ethanol preservative using a serological pipette and transfer it to a 50 mL falcon tube.

steps.title: Seal Filter Outflow
steps.instruction: Seal the outflow of the filter with parafilm.

steps.title: Add Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1800 μL of sucrose lysis buffer (SLB) to the sample.

steps.title: Seal Filter Inflow
steps.instruction: Seal the inflow opening of the filter with parafilm.

steps.title: Store Filter Units
steps.instruction: Label the filter units and store them at -80°C for downstream DNA extraction.

steps.title: Perform DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Follow the extraction procedures for Environmental DNA: DNA Extraction from 0.22µm Sterivex Filters - Phenol-Chloroform by Andreas Novotny.
